parent_objective: design the terminal-boundary materialization branch selected by M1224
blocked_by: M1222 has action-divergent rows but no outcome degradation
M1224 selects terminal-boundary materialization as the next branch
invalidates: claiming M1222 action divergence is enough for causal-history proof

public_gates: M1225 may design terminal-boundary materialization only
M1225 must preserve the P0 human-view no-wheel actor contract
M1225 must decide whether existing relocation tooling can consume M1222 rows or an adapter is required
M1225 must include source-diversity and active-set-collapse guards
M1225 must not run source mining or relocation replay
M1225 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not use action-only rows as proof
do not ignore M1177 active-set collapse risk

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs how to convert M1222 action-divergent candidate rows into bounded terminal-boundary materialization tests
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/design only; no closed-loop proof, training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1222 rows cannot provide relocation-compatible geometry
stop if no source-diversity guard can prevent active-set collapse
stop if design requires hidden/oracle actor inputs
fallback_plan: design an adapter/exporter if existing relocation tooling cannot consume M1222 rows
route to stronger cross-family/fault source if terminal-boundary materialization is not viable
route to branch synthesis if repeated materialization attempts collapse to one active set
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1224 opens terminal-boundary materialization after causal-history branch synthesis

blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: source-diversity and active-set-collapse gates are specified
next implementation or run manifest is pre-registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1225 remains design-only and must not upgrade M1222 action divergence to history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: normal-history success and wrong-history degradation criteria
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Outcome-level history necessity remains blocked until a later materialization run produces source-diverse margin or success degradation.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization design is not viable, route to stronger cross-family/fault source rather than training.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1222 action-divergent rows can be turned into a bounded terminal-boundary materialization test with explicit source-diversity and active-set-collapse guards.
success_criteria: existing-tool versus adapter route is selected
source-diversity and active-set-collapse gates are specified
no source mining, relocation replay, outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs

commands.name: write_terminal_boundary_materialization_design
commands.command: Design M1222 action-divergent terminal-boundary materialization without running relocation

decision_rule: M1225 passes if it chooses a concrete materialization implementation/run route with source-diversity and active-set-collapse guards.
